common: Full-color pixel art, strict {cols}x{rows} grid, every cell a single perfectly aligned solid color, {pitch_x:g}px wide and {pitch_y:g}px tall. Use distinct hues for each material. Navy outlines, illuminated surfaces and distinguishable colored shadow material. No antialiasing, dithering, gradients, thin texture, text, border or visible grid.

knight.prompt: Full-color pixel art of this exact right-facing chibi knight, 64x64 logical pixels per frame. One solid color per cell. Blonde yellow hair and one upright hooked ahoge, light peach skin and one black eye, silver-white shoulder plates, breastplate and shin guards, royal blue tunic and blue scabbard behind the hip, brown belt, dark navy outline and boots. Large head, bold 1-pixel features, transparent background, no anti-aliasing, gradients, dithering, text, floor or grid lines. Show a two-tone braided lock behind the cheek, one white eye glint, a curved upright hair tuft, a round silver pauldron with one glint, engraved chest armor, solid blue tunic, gold buckle and gold sword crossguard. Flat solid colors, no checker pattern, no dithering.

frames: Convert the reference knight girl into an original chibi sprite, full body, standing, facing right. Keep her blonde hair and one upright hair tuft, round silver pauldrons and plate armor, dark tunic, and blue sword scabbard at her hip. Big head, small body, one dark eye with a white glint. Keep her body in columns 16–47 and boots on the bottom row.
